component.name: Perk
component.summary: Keep your computer awake, never your laptop in a bag

description.p: Long download? Presentation? Reading a long document? Perk keeps your screen on and stops your computer from dozing off, for as long as you need, with one click from the system tray.
When you close the lid, Perk steps aside straight away, so your laptop sleeps like it normally would.

ul.li: One click: click the cup in the tray to stay awake, click again to stop
Stay awake indefinitely, or for 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours or any time you like
Optionally start the timer only once you step away; Perk then steps in just before your computer would sleep
Closing the lid always lets your laptop sleep
Pauses itself when the battery runs low

screenshot.caption: The cup in your tray shows whether Perk is keeping your computer awake
Pick a time, and optionally start the timer only when you step away
